recognize_zh: 剛果紅染色在偏光顯微鏡下，血管壁內的無定形沉積物呈現黃綠色雙折射（apple-green birefringence），而周圍的膠原則是白色光亮；這種位於血管壁的綠色雙折射就是類澱粉沉積（amyloid）的確診依據。
features: Apple-green (with yellow) birefringence of amorphous deposits under polarized light
Deposits localized to walls/lumina of medium-sized blood vessels
Surrounding collagen shows non-specific white birefringence
Adjacent adipose tissue visible as honeycomb spaces
Congo red-stained section viewed with crossed polarizers
describe_en: Congo red-stained section examined under polarized light shows amorphous deposits within the walls of several medium-sized blood vessels in fibroadipose tissue. These deposits display characteristic apple-green to yellow birefringence, distinct from the white birefringence of surrounding collagen. The findings confirm vascular amyloid deposition; in a patient with plasma cell myeloma, AL amyloidosis is favored, and amyloid typing by mass spectrometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: Collagen and hyaline change show white or silvery birefringence without Congo red affinity rather than apple-green birefringence.
Non-amyloid monoclonal light chain deposits are Congo red-negative and non-birefringent, with granular deposits on electron microscopy.
Morphology is identical, so the amyloid protein must be typed by mass spectrometry or immunostaining to distinguish it from AL amyloid.
